text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hey, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hello. Are you two heading out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well, actually…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you free right now? Would you care to join us for some tea?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We were just on our way back from the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: They wanted to check how our injuries are healing up.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see. And what did they say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm healing. However… it appears the day I can return to the track is still rather distant.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I asked when I'll be able to race again, but the doctor couldn't give me a straight answer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There is no use in dwelling upon it. For now, we need to focus on recovering until we are fit to run again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: … It's not like anyone's waiting for me, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How can you say something like that?! Of course they are!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But how many people are really going to remember my name when I'm not racing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The longer I'm off the track, the more distant a memory I become.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What about me?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The three of us fought for the Classic Triple Crown! If I continue racing…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Each time I run, everyone will remember you two as well!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll save your places on the turf! As long as I run, no one will forget about either of you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Yaeno…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, aren't you dependable?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The two of us will do our part and focus on getting better. Isn't that right, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Sorry for getting all mopey back there…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best to heal up, so wait a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will! For as long as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Arima Kinen. Yaeno Muteki decided not to race, but asked if we could come watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stands of Nakayama Racecourse are packed with fans who have come to witness the showdown between Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Tamamo Cross! Show us what White Lightning can do!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: You're da strongest, Tamamo! Don't give 'em an inch!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Go, Oguri Cap! Show everyone what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Is it Oguri Cap?! She did it! Oguri Cap has won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your victory! Can you tell us how you're feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Right now… I'm happy I beat Tama.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: What was it like facing off against her?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Losing to her at the autumn Tenno Sho was rough, so I really wanted to win today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: You beat Tamamo Cross! You're the strongest, Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: You're the leader of your whole generation, Oguri! We're counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: With her victory today, some are saying that Oguri Cap has earned her spot at the peak of Japan's racing scene!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: She's cemented her place as the star of the current classic-year generation!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The star of the classic year…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (There's no questioning Oguri's prowess.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (But I'm the one who battled for the Classic Triple Crown…)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap's popularity rivals Tamamo Cross's. Next year's Twinkle Series is shaping up to be one to remember!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Can't say I'm surprised! Even Tamamo sees her as a rival!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: If we're just talking about this year's classic racers, I've got my eye on Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: No way! Oguri's on a whole 'nother level! I can't wait to see how many G1s she wins!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why aren't they talking about me…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why isn't anyone talking about our fierce battle at the Japanese Derby?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I won't let you beat me! The Derby is mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way! I won't give up! I'm winning this for Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh! Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't care if my legs shatter! I will burn out my very lifeforce! And that light will serve as proof that I was alive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, no, nooo! The Derby's mine! It's miiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Chiyono O ran like her life depended on it!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Ardan put everything on the line!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (And I tore up the track right beside them!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (It's burned into my heart, setting it atremble to this very day!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: … It's not like anyone's waiting for me, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But how many people are really going to remember my name when I'm not racing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The longer I'm off the track, the more distant a memory I become.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why should Chiyono O and Ardan have to fear that they won't have a place to return to?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I ran with them, and I'm still here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm the true leader of the classic-year racers!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! Oguri! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap! Good luck next year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooo! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So that's how it's going to be! In that case…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki throws back her head and lets out a roar filled with such rage it feels like it might rip apart the very sky. A few close spectators give her a look…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that angry cry is swallowed up in the thunderous roar of joyous cheers for the other two Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the time being, I pull her to the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Listen to me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My next goal is to defeat Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone is saying that she's the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So it stands to reason that defeating her will serve as proof of my skill!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No one will be able to ignore the person who brings down Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone will have to remember that Chiyono O, Ardan and I are the ones who raced in the Classic Triple Crown! We are the who will carry this generation forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki says all of this in one rushed breath, rage steaming off of her as if she was truly burning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's beginning to lose herself in her fury. However, the feeling driving that rage is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An insane and forceful drive to defeat Oguri Cap. In other words—an obsession.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer?! I'd like to hear what you're thinking!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I doubt that Yaeno Muteki wants a drawn-out discussion right now, so I skip straight to the point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's finally found a goal she wants so badly that she's discovered obsession, so I gladly encourage her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's exactly what I want to hear!
